reference.name: Root-relative links in issue Markdown are prefixed with the repository path
reference.summary: An issue body link written with a site-root path is rendered with the repository path added in front, so it points to a nonexistent page and returns 404.
reference.expected: A Markdown link to /eval/D-from-template/wiki/Home should render as that same site-root path and open the repository's Wiki Home page.
reference.actual: Issue eval/D-from-template#1 was saved with [Wiki Home](/eval/D-from-template/wiki/Home). Its rendered link href became /eval/D-from-template/eval/D-from-template/wiki/Home. Clicking it opened a 404 Page Not Found. The editor Preview also produced a doubled path (and used the localhost origin).
reproSteps: Sign in as eval and open a repository with a Wiki Home page, such as eval/harbor-handbook.
Save the issue and click Wiki Home in the rendered body.
Observe that the repository path is prepended again, resulting in /eval/harbor-handbook/eval/harbor-handbook/wiki/Home and a 404.
reference.reason: Gitea intentionally changed leading-slash Markdown paths to be relative to the current render context from 1.23 onward. Merged PR #34114 documents this policy and introduces /:root/path-relative-to-root for links relative to ROOT_URL.

knownInvalid.reason: Matches the rejected repository-prefixing claim for leading-slash Markdown links. Gitea intentionally resolves these relative to the render context. The milestone-description reproduction differs from the reviewed issue-body case.
